items.title: New DeFi incident study separates project audit history from actual incident-path scope
items.summary: A new arXiv preprint analyzes 135 DeFi security incidents from the first half of 2026 and, for the 68 incidents where public pre-incident audit history was identified, reports 46 attack paths outside all identified audit scopes, 20 inside and 2 unresolved. The authors explicitly distinguish a project being audited from the incident path actually being in audit scope, which is directly relevant to exact-scope verification and capability claims.
items.agent_notes: This is a preprint, not a peer-reviewed final result. Preserve its corpus/method limitations and do not generalize the reported percentages beyond the studied incidents. It is useful evidence for keeping project-level audit labels separate from exact incident-path scope.
